data.title: 轻井泽惠 · 游轮甲板热带比基尼的慵懒侧卧

data.location: 豪华邮轮顶层日光浴甲板
data.action: 斜倚在白色躺椅上，单手拉低墨镜露出狡黠紫眸，双腿优雅交叠，指尖轻勾比基尼系带
data.lighting: 纯净热烈的南国海风阳光，甲板木纹与遮阳伞光影分明
data.camera: 中远景全身微俯机位，展现完美少女身段与海阔天空
data.promptProse: Kei Karuizawa lounges comfortably upon a white deck chair on the sundeck of a luxury cruise liner skimming across azure waters. She wears an eye-catching tropical-print halterneck bikini that accentuates her sun-kissed, trim silhouette. Lowering her trendy heart-shaped sunglasses with one manicured finger, she peeks over the rims with a teasing, self-assured smirk beneath the brilliant tropical sun.
data.animaCaption: Lounging on the cruise deck in her tropical bikini, Kei lowers her sunglasses with a playful, knowing smirk under the bright sun.
